grammar.title: 埋下伏笔
lines: Such is human nature, that a great many people are often willing to sacrifice higher pay for the privilege of becoming white-collar workers. nature n.本性、天性 for the privilege of ... 为了...的好处、特权（of 引出同位语解释说明好处、特权） This can give rise to curious situations, as it did in the case of Alfred Bloggs who worked as a dustman for the Ellesmere Corporation . give rise to sth. (fml.) 导致... work as 从事...工作 造句：Stress can give rise to mental diseases, as it did in the case of Mike Johnson who worked as an engineer for General Motors. 压力会导致精神上的一些疾病，正如在通用汽车公司工程师迈克·约翰逊身上发生的情况一样。
Such is human nature, that a great many people are often willing to sacrifice higher pay for the privilege of becoming white-collar workers.
倒装：human nature is Such 解释 such 做同位语从句 目的状语
Excuse me, nature calls. 去方便、如厕、唱歌(少数民族方言)、委婉的表达上厕所
He is kind by nature.他生性善良。
Such is human nature that ... 人的本性是... Such is human nature that we all love to get something for nothing.
It is human nature that ... 主语从句（强调“人的本性”差意思，使用倒装更好）
Such is human nature that we don't treasure what we have until we lose it. 人性就是，失去了才懂得珍惜。
Human nature is such that a great many people ... 正常的语序(非倒装)
The conditions of society are such that skills have to be paid for in the same way that goods are paid for at a shop. NCE3-27
be willing to do 乐意做某事 I shook my head and held up five fingers indicating that I was willing to pay £ 5.NCE3-28

be ready to do 乐意干某事 So for us ordinary people, just be ready to do what we can to help others. 所以对于我们普通人来说，刚准备尽我们所能去帮助别人。 If your order is large enough we are ready to reduce our prices by 5%. 如果你方订货量大，我们乐意让利5%。
be prepared to do 乐意或已准备干某事 Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country is beyond me.NCE3-41
Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country is beyond me.NCE3-41
This can give rise to curious situations, as it did in the case of Alfred Bloggs who worked as a dustman for the Ellesmere Corporation.
主句（观点） 引导 方式状语从句 定语从句
方式状语从句（例证：as it did / does in the case of ... who ...）
This can cause curious situations. Alfred Bloggs was an example. He worked ... 初级水平
The president's absence gave rise to speculations about his health.
I work as an English teacher for New Oriental School. 简历

sentences.title: 描述举例（开始交待故事）
lines: When he got married, Alf was too embarrassed to say anything to his wife about his job. get married 结婚 Every morning, he left home dressed in a smart black suit. He then changed into overalls and spent the next eight hours as a dustman. change (out of....) / (into ...) 换衣服 Before returning home at night, he took a shower and changed back into his suit. 使用完成时的动名词可以使用一般时doing与being done代替，那么什么时间使用完成时 having done与having been done？当需要强调“动名词”发生的时间要比谓语动词更早时就需要使用完成时态的“动名词”。
marry sb. 嫁给...娶了...
Will you marry me? 求婚（男女都可）
be married to sb.（用被动强调）嫁给了...娶了...
The girl was married to me. 女孩儿嫁给了我
The girl was married with me. 女孩儿带着我一起嫁了(我TM成陪嫁品了？)
The girl was engaged to me. 女孩儿与我订婚了
be (dressed) in ... 穿着(xxx的衣服) He was (dressed) in a smart black suit. Men In Black 黑衣人（电影名）
sb. wear sth. 某人穿着... He left home wearing a smart black suit. 主动
You'd better change out of the red jacket into a blue one. 你最好把那件红夹克换成一件蓝的。
spend ... on sth. / (in) doing 重点是与介词的搭配 花钱 I spent a lot of money on food.
花时间 I spent a lot of time on homework. I spent a lot of time (in) learning English.
度过 I spent my summer vacation in Hainan Province. I treasured every minute I spent with your family.
动名词的时态和语态
时态/语态 主动 被动
一般时 doing being done
完成时 having done having been done
Before returning home at night, he took a shower and changed back into his suit.
后发生(使用一般时) 先发生
After gazing at the display for several minutes, Mr. Taylor went back into his shop. NCE3-6
先发生(一般时可代替完成时) 后发生
After having gazed at the display for several minutes, Mr. Taylor went back into his shop.
Four days after (having set) setting out, while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic... NCE3-10
Ashamed of having acted so rashly, Dimitri apologized to Aleko for having accused him.NCE3-16(介词+宾语=发生在谓语之前)
Pretending to speak seriously, one of the workmen asked if he might make a telephone call before being taken to the station. NCE3-40(一般时的被动)
After having been wounded towards the end of the war, he had been sent to hospital and was separated from his unit.NCE3-36(完成时的被动)

expand.title: 结果
lines: Alf did this for over two years and his fellow dustmen kept his secret. fellow + 名词 身份、地位相同的一类人 Alf's wife has never discovered that she married a dustman and she never will , for Alf has just found another job. 通过时态简写句子 He will soon be working in an office. will be doing 表达一种可预见性（安排好了、预期会发生） He will be earning only half as much as he used to , but he feels that his rise in status is well worth the loss of money . The day when Beijing won the right to host the 2008 Olympic Games is worth being celebrated celebrating / celebration. The day when Beijing won the right to host the 2008 Olympic Games is worthy of celebration / to be celebrated. From now on, he will wear a suit all day and others will call him 'Mr. Bloggs', not Alf.
fellow dustm e n 清洁工同事 们
fellow actor s 同事演员 们 ：指在同一部电影、电视剧或舞台剧中合作的演员。
The gaoler looked on eagerly, anxious to see if his fellow actor had at last learnt his lines. NCE3-22
fellow student s = schoolmate 同一学校或同一课堂中的其他学生 们
fellow citizen s 同胞 们

In so far as any inquiry is a secret one, it naturally limits all those engaged in carrying it out from effective contact with their fellow scientists either in other countries or in universities, or even, often enough, in other departments of the same firm. NCE4-15
My fellow Chinese / American s ... 我的中国/美国 同胞 们
We would lay less stress on 'facts and figures' and more on a good memory, on applied psychology, and on the capacity of a man to get along with his fellow citizens. NCE4-33
And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.
workmate Do you tangle with your new workmate? 你会自己的新同事吵架吗？
colleague One night, the gaoler decided to play a joke on his colleague to find out if, after so many performances, he had managed to learn the contents of the letter by heart.NCE3-22
associate The dictionary meaning of the term "associate" is "colleague"; "friend"; "companion". 词典中“伙伴”一词的意思是“同事”；“朋友”；“伴侣”。
Alf's wife has never discovered that she married a dustman and she never will, for Alf has just found another job.
主 + 谓 宾语从句 并列句(省略discover) 原因状语从句
I was , am and will be your friend. 我过去是，现在是，将来也会是你的朋友。
I love you. Always have ,always will .
They will be arriving here tomorrow.
Professor Wang will be taking charge of our department next Monday.王教授下周一将负责我们系。
He will be earning only half as much as he used to (earn) , but he feels that his rise in status is well worth the loss of money.
将来进行时 比较状语从句 引导原因状语从句 宾语从句
英语中表达倍数的三种方式
A is ... times as ... as B A是B的...倍 His salary is three times as much as mine. 他的工资是我的三倍。 The box is four times as big as that one. 这个箱子是那个箱子四倍大。
A is ... times the amount of B A 的(长、高、宽、价格...)是B的...倍 the amount 可以使用：the number, the size, the length, the width / breadth, the height, the value, the price ...

A is .. times 比较级 than B 通过形容词的比较级确定比较内容 His salary is three times the amount of mine. A is ... times the amount of B His salary is twice more than mine. 他的工资是我的两倍。A is .. times 比较级 than B The box is four times the size of that one. A is ... times the size of B The box is three times bigger than that one.
be worth sth. The matter is worth consideration.
doing (只能主动) The matter is worth considering.
be worthy of sth. The matter is worthy of consideration.
to do (主动) The book is worthy to read.
to be done (被动) The matter is worthy of to be considered.
